entries.title: Transparency Ledger release automation made Cloudflare-native
entries.summary: Transparency Ledger release ingestion no longer depends on GitHub or any external repository API. Release manifests now enter an isolated Cloudflare R2 inbox, are validated and appended idempotently to the authoritative D1 ledger, and are archived in R2 after successful processing. The Worker records each synchronization attempt, outcome, and last archived manifest in D1, while the source repository remains an optional public inspection mirror rather than a runtime dependency.

changes: Removed GitHub Contents API polling from the civic Worker
Added a bounded Cloudflare R2 release-manifest inbox
Preserved idempotent append-only D1 registration by event key
Archived successfully synchronized manifests inside R2
Recorded synchronization attempts, success, failure, and cursor state in D1
Kept WordPress publication synchronization independent from release ingestion
Updated the release-registration helper to enqueue through Wrangler without a ledger administration secret
